title: help answers as list, and list carries the device's bin shortcuts
intention: help is a root verb every device answers, defined once in the base shim, answering exactly as list does; list carries the device's bin shortcuts beside its verbs and views; a cold_list function answers the root verbs and shortcuts with no shim built and no bus opened, so the cairn command's help works when nothing else is up.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: cairn/tools/base/shim.py:54 ROOT_VERB_SEMANTICS holds list, show, get, stop, start, settings — no help; list (shim.py:1128-1149) prints verbs, views, panes and semantics, and nothing from the device's bin; cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_root_verb_vocabulary.py pins the six. Akien 2026-11-05: 'help can just call list. help is specifically an anticipation of the behavior of the other monkeys in my species.' Help is asked from anywhere, so it is everywhere, defined once (outline 8.4.3.2).
traces_to: Telos: the operator's one interface (outline 8.4). Law 1 (one definition, inherited — no per-device copies), RULE 1 (bin/cairn reaches it through cairn.tools.base.shim, the base tool's public interface).
how: Add 'help' to ROOT_VERB_SEMANTICS; in _resolve map help to list before dispatch; factor the bin read into cold_list(device_id, instance_root) (honouring CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT) that list calls and that bin/cairn calls in-process when the bus is down; update test_root_verb_vocabulary's six to seven; red-first proof over a scratch instance root.
falsifier: (1) ROOT_VERB_SEMANTICS carries help, whose meaning names it the word people type for list; (2) for a fixture shim, resolve(['help']) and resolve(['list']) return identical text, data and exit; (3) list's data carries 'shortcuts' — each executable in the device's instance bin with its first comment line, a non-executable file absent — and its text a shortcuts: section; (4) a module-level cold_list(device_id, instance_root) returns the root verbs with their semantics and the bin shortcuts while constructing no shim and opening no bus (proved with the bus modules made unimportable); (5) test_root_verb_vocabulary passes over the seven.
